'''Spatz''' was a high tech [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] machine.<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> It was played in the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] at the [[Aspre Plunge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]]<ref name="SR" /> the [[Ace of Sabres]] on [[Kluistar]],<ref name="WGSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> and the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="GG2-2" />
